headline: Villar Mir Heirs Turn Toward Renewables and Struggle in Industry Two Years After the Entrepreneur's Death
summary: Ferroglobe, the largest industrial holding of the Villar Mir Group, has lost 40% of its value since July 2024. The company has triggered a temporary layoff plan (ERTE) at its Sabón plant.
why: Ferroglobe is a listed producer of silicon metal and ferroalloys used in steel, chemicals and solar applications. Its performance and restructuring affect investors in industrial metals and the Villar Mir Group.
